title: krops virtualized e2e scenario
description: Phase 3 shape (issue #355) for one stateful cloud API scenario. A scenario binds an ordered set of request/response steps to a WireMock Scenario state machine: a step matches only in its requiredState, responds, and optionally advances to newState. Phase 3 tooling converts each scenario document into WireMock mapping files (scenarioName = name, requiredScenarioState = requiredState, newScenarioState = newState). This schema is the authoring contract; validate with any draft 2020-12 JSON Schema implementation.

name.description: Scenario name; becomes WireMock's scenarioName on every generated mapping.

description.description: What reconcile behavior this scenario models (for example: Bucket create, drift, delete).

initialState.description: State the scenario starts in. 'Started' is WireMock's built-in initial state; override only when chaining scenarios.

states.description: Declared state names for readability and tooling checks; steps reference these in requiredState and newState.

steps.description: Ordered request/response steps. Order matters only for readability; matching is governed by states.

request.description: WireMock request matcher (method, url/urlPath/urlPattern, queryParameters, headers, bodyPatterns), passed through to the generated mapping.

response.description: WireMock response definition (status, headers, body or jsonBody), passed through to the generated mapping.

requiredState.description: requiredScenarioState: the step matches only while the scenario is in this state. Set to 'Started' (or the value of initialState) to restrict this step to the initial state; omit only if the step should match regardless of current scenario state.

newState.description: newScenarioState: state entered after this step matches. Omit to keep the current state.
